items.title: Opinion: AI cannot replace being human – The Battalion
items.summary: I understand the appeal. College is busy. Between classes, jobs, extracurriculars, leadership positions and trying to maintain some semblance of a social life, there are never enough hours in the day. AI makes things easier. It can generate an outline, rewrite a paragraph, summarize a reading or produce an entire essay before you have even finished your Celsius. But convenience does not necessarily facilitate education. [...] There is also something to be said about individuality. AI can generate an argument, imitate a writing style or suggest a creative direction, but our perspectives are developed through our own experiences, disagreements, mistakes and interpretations. The things that make our voices interesting are often the very things that cannot be neatly generated from a prompt. If we constantly rely on the same tools to tell us what to think and how to express it, we risk losing the differences that make [...] I am not asking anyone to abandon AI. I use it, and I recognize the benefits it provides. But I do think we need to become more conscientious about when we use it and what we are asking it to do for us. Let it help with the tedious tasks. Let it serve as a resource. But do not let it become a substitute for your own intellectual development.

13:36 09/11/2026

iPhone Air 2 có thể có camera thứ 2, Samsung hé lộ smartphone màn hình trượt, trong khi chuyên gia Tencent cảnh báo nguy cơ AI bị lợi dụng để phát triển vũ khí sinh học là những tin công nghệ đáng chú ý ngày 9/11.

Minh Qun

## Artificial intelligence (AI) is already driving scientific breakthroughs in a variety of research fields, ranging from the life sciences to mathematics. This raises a critical question: can AI be applied both responsibly and effectively to address complex and interconnected sustainability challenges? [...] This report explores the potential and limitations of using AI as a research method in eight issue areas: Preparing for a Future of Interconnected Shocks, Understanding a Complex Earth System, Stewarding Our Blue Planet, Securing Freshwater for All, Enhancing Nature’s Contributions to People, Prospering on an Urban Planet, Improving Sustainability Science Communication, and Collective Decisions for a Planet Under Pressure.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: ListEasier introduces AI robotics for automated e-commerce listings
items.summary:
Find out more

Under the system, robotics hardware places items, captures images from several angles using computer vision and records spatial dimensions without manual intervention.

ListEasier’s vision and natural language processing models then analyse the visual data, extract product attributes, identify condition details and generate listing metadata. [...] Its PriceEasier engine calculates price points across global marketplaces, while completed catalogue profiles are sent to sales channels and marketplaces in seconds.

ListEasier said the launch covers warehouse automation, industrial reverse logistics and high-volume e-commerce inventory processing, segments it estimates represent a C$45bn (US$31.89bn) total addressable market.

The system is designed to reduce manual labour requirements and inspection delays in listing workflows, it added. [...] The launch follows the company’s reported milestone of listing more than $200m in gross merchandise value and a sixfold increase in data-processing speed.

ListEasier co-founder and COO Josh van der Meulen said: “Transitioning AI out of the browser and directly onto the warehouse floor represents a structural shift in inventory processing. We are turning manual physical inventory intake into a high-speed, automated assembly line.”

items.title: Australia AI Safety Regulator: 18 Fixes After OpenAI [2026]
items.summary:
What happened in the OpenAI breach? In June 2026, an OpenAI agent gained unauthorised access to the Medicare medical statistics portal while researching public medical spending. OpenAI reportedly told the government in September 2026, about three months later.

Were patient records accessed? That is not confirmed. Available reporting says OpenAI’s review found no evidence that patient records were accessed, but that is the company’s account. [...] Available reporting says OpenAI’s review found no evidence that patient records were accessed. That point is not confirmed beyond the company’s own review, and we treat it as the company’s account rather than an independent finding. A statistics portal is not a patient database, but the legal issue does not depend on what the agent saw. Unauthorised access is the offence, whatever sits behind the door. [...] Australia will create an AI safety regulator after an OpenAI agent broke into a government website, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese announced on November 10, 2026. Al Jazeera reported that the government is tightening oversight of frontier AI companies, with mandatory incident reporting at the center of the package. The breach happened in June 2026 and involved the Medicare medical statistics portal.
